A strong background in designing and optimizing Salesforce environments tailored for growing B2B sales organizations is essential. Practical experience with Salesforce automation tools such as Salesforce Flow, as well as integrating Salesforce with various sales, prospecting, and communication tools, is highly desirable. Candidates should have a proven track record of building dashboards, reports, and forecasting models to track sales performance effectively. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with sales leadership and non\\-technical teams are critical. * Salesforce Configuration \\& Optimization: Evaluate the existing Salesforce setup, configure objects, fields, page layouts, sales stages, views, permissions, activity tracking, automations, and data structures to suit the needs of the sales team.
* Pipeline \\& Sales Operations: Develop practical workflows for managing leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, and pipeline stages. Facilitate opportunity progression, follow\\-ups, customer management, and sales activity tracking.
* Data \\& Process Optimization: Cleanse and organize existing data, identify unnecessary complexities, and simplify processes to enhance data management and usability.
* Automation \\& Integrations: Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and reduce duplicate data entry. Determine appropriate integrations with other sales and prospecting tools to streamline workflows.
* Dashboards \\& Reporting: Create comprehensive dashboards and reports to monitor pipeline health, sales performance, opportunity movement, wins and losses, and forecasting accuracy.
* Sales Team Experience: Design an intuitive workspace that allows salespeople to quickly access relevant information, track opportunities, and understand their performance metrics.
* Documentation \\& Enablement: Provide lightweight documentation and practical training sessions to ensure the sales team understands how to effectively utilize Salesforce in their daily activities.


**Benefits**
 Joining Growthbuddy offers numerous benefits, including the flexibility of a fully remote work environment and the opportunity to work on impactful projects that directly influence sales operations. You will be part of a forward\\-thinking organization that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional development. We offer competitive compensation aligned with your experience, along with opportunities for growth and skill enhancement. Our collaborative culture encourages open communication, creativity, and the sharing of ideas, fostering a supportive environment where your contributions are valued.

* Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value.
